steps.summary: Set auto-refresh to 1 minute via the top-bar refresh picker (1m) and persisted it. Because this build shows no Save dashboard button in view mode, I clicked 'Edit' to enter edit mode, then Save dashboard; the dialog reported 'No changes to save' until I ticked the offered 'Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default' checkbox (no 'Update default time range' checkbox was offered, as only the refresh value differed), which enabled Save; after clicking Save the 'Dashboard saved' status alert appeared. Verified with a full reload of /d/{{v4}}/{{v5}} with no time parameters: the refresh interval button now reads '1m' (aria-label '...current interval 1 minute selected') and the time picker reads 'Last 6 hours'. Refresh interval before: Off ("Auto refresh turned off"); after reload: 1m.
